Terminal responses include completion status, CertScore score and risk metadata when available, coverage, p

tools.name: certscore_get_report_evidence_page
tools.description: For a focused question, use section=consent, gpc, policy, tracking, transport or forms. This returns selected retained report sections plus shared scan, score, findings and coverage context. Preserve section on cursor continuation; unselected or not-returned fields are not evidence of absence. Use w

tools.name: certscore_get_scan_bundle
tools.description: Main answer for a completed or completed-limited scan: canonical findings, next steps, supporting evidence, score, date/region, coverage and report URL. An existing scanId is enough; no new scan is created. The evidence index describes response delivery, never evidence absence. Optional next actions

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "light" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: certscore_scan_site, certscore_get_scan_status, certscore_get_report_evidence_page, certscore_get_scan_bundle · Private data: certscore_get_report_evidence_page · Public sink: certscore_scan_site, certscore_get_report_evidence_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: certscore_scan_site, certscore_get_scan_status, certscore_get_report_evidence_page, certscore_get_scan_bundle · Private data: certscore_get_report_evidence_page · Public sink: certscore_scan_site, certscore_get_report_evidence_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
